name: MEMO CX15 cooling fan
description:
Cooling Power: Features a 15W semiconductor chip (TEC) that can reduce device temperatures by up to 23°C.
Mounting Options: Supports both magnetic attachment (MagSafe compatible) and a detachable back clip for universal use on iPhones, Androids, and tablets.
Noise Level: Operates at a quiet 25dB–26dB, roughly equivalent to a whisper.
Display & Lighting: Includes a central temperature display and customizable RGB lighting with multiple modes (Rainbow, Breathing, Gradient).
